requirements.text: The application shall provide a graphical board with a height of 5x and a width of 4x, where x is between 50 and 100 pixels.
The board shall contain four square blocks of size x, four rectangular blocks of size 2x by x, one block of size x by 2x, and one square block of size 2x.
The application shall allow users to select, deselect, and move blocks within the board boundaries using mouse input.
The application shall prevent blocks from overlapping or moving closer than 0.05x to other blocks.
The application shall support undo and redo functionality for up to 1,000 previous actions.
The application shall track and display the elapsed time and the total number of moves made by the user.
The application shall detect the end of the game when the large square block reaches the bottom of the board.
The application shall maintain a persistent file of the top 10 player scores, including name, move count, and time.
The application shall provide functionality to save the current game state, including block positions, move history, and elapsed time, to a file.
The application shall allow users to open previously saved game files to restore the game state.
The application shall provide a menu bar with options for Game management, Action control, Statistics viewing/erasing, and Help.
The application shall prompt the user to save the game upon exiting if the current state has not been saved.
The application shall support a minimum screen resolution of 800x600 pixels.
The user interface shall be accessible via standard mouse and keyboard input devices.
The application shall be developed using the Qt graphical library to ensure cross-platform compatibility.
The application shall be portable to the Windows operating system.
